purpose: Machine-readable plumbing design/checking rules derived from code structure and publicly accessible code information.

rules.condition: Potable water supply/distribution has an unprotected cross-connection or backflow risk.
rules.action: Apply the appropriate potable-water protection/backflow requirement.

rules.condition: Water distribution design does not demonstrate demand, pressure and pipe sizing compliance.
rules.action: Verify water demand, fixture requirements and pipe sizing using SBC 701.
